subject: Re: Partner onboarding — CPPO entitlement reconciliation & PO path for ConvergeTech
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <a.gupta@convergetech.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: ops@channelcloud.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO: entitlement mapping + PO path question

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at ConvergeTech is ready to move forward but we have two blockers before we can issue a PO:

1) Entitlement mapping — our finance team needs a clear mapping of SKUs/entitlements between the Redwood listing and the Channel reseller invoice (ChannelCloud). We need to know how the CPPO will appear on our invoice and who is directly invoicing us.
2) PO path — because we’re using our corporate procurement system you need to confirm whether we should send the PO to Redwood or to ChannelCloud (we have a reseller agreement with ChannelCloud).

Attached is a draft PO (Purchase_Order_CT-4567.pdf). Can you confirm the accounting path and share any entitlement matrix you have?

We’d like to close this week if possible.

Best,
Aisha Gupta
Head of Procurement, ConvergeTech

---
Attachment: Purchase_Order_CT-4567.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB)

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: Aisha Gupta <a.gupta@convergetech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ops@channelcloud.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO: entitlement mapping + PO path question

Hi Aisha — thanks for the PO and the clear ask. Short answer: we can support both flows, but because you already have a reseller agreement with ChannelCloud the simplest operational path is ChannelCloud-issued invoicing with a CPPO entitlement split.

Proposal (high level):
- ChannelCloud will be the bill-to (they invoice ConvergeTech).
- Redwood will be the listed SaaS vendor in the CPPO and will grant the entitlements to the ChannelCloud subscriber.
- The entitlement mapping we use for activation (SKU -> entitlement ID) is attached as an XLSX and has a column called "invoice_line_description" you can pass to finance.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll loop in Ben (partner ops) to confirm the invoice/billing flow and any reseller metadata ChannelCloud needs.
2) Marissa from CS will confirm technical entitlement provisioning and whether we need a separate onboarding ticket for entitlement sync.
3) Once agreed, we’ll provide a DocuSign-ready order form and a final entitlement matrix for procurement.

I’m attaching the CPPO_entitlement_matrix.xlsx and a short mutual action plan with milestones.

If you want Redwood to be the payor for a limited time so you can test first, we can discuss an interim billing arrangement — let me know.

Onward —
David Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0197

---
Attachments: CPPO_entitlement_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24KB); Mutual_Action_Plan_ConvergeTech.pdf (application/pdf, 56KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: david_kim@redwood.com, ops@channelcloud.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO: entitlement mapping + PO path question

Thanks David — looping in operational details. ChannelCloud Ops, quick answers below: 

- ChannelCloud can be the invoicing party; we will configure the CPPO so the entitlement is associated with the ChannelCloud buyer account (we mark channel:channelcloud in the AWS CPPO metadata).
- To avoid invoice reconciliation issues, please have ConvergeTech include the ChannelCloud reseller ID on the PO (we will share the exact ID).
- On the Redwood side we will set the mapping so the invoice line description matches the "invoice_line_description" column in the attached matrix.

ChannelCloud: please confirm the reseller ID we should use and whether ChannelCloud requires a consolidated invoice or line-item level detail. That will determine whether we need a separate mapping sheet.

I also flagged a short internal task: Marissa, please confirm whether we need entitlement-only onboarding or a full account provisioning. That affects lead time.

Ben Carter
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
---
[internal note: I created CPPO activation ticket #ACT-4821]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: a.gupta@convergetech.com, david_kim@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ops@channelcloud.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO: entitlement mapping + PO path question

Hi Aisha — thanks for sending the PO. Quick operational notes from CS: 

- For ConvergeTech’s planned usage we recommend entitlement-level provisioning (not a manual one-off). That means once ChannelCloud accepts the CPPO we push provisioning via our entitlement service; no separate onboarding ticket needed unless you want custom roles.
- Please confirm the account email that will own the ChannelCloud subscription (we need this for activation).
- I’ll prepare a short DocuSign order form for signature and include the exact ChannelCloud reseller ID and invoice memo text that finance should put on the PO to avoid hold-ups.

Laura (finance ops) — can you confirm whether Redwood needs the PO for our records or if ChannelCloud will be sufficient? If we need it, we’ll request a copy of the final signed order.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_ConvergeTech.pdf (application/pdf, 56KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: a.gupta@convergetech.com, david_kim@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ops@channelcloud.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: PO routing + signature link

Hi Aisha — looping finance. For clarity: Redwood requires a copy of the invoice for our audit trail but ChannelCloud will be the bill-to/collector. Please do the following so we can complete activation without delays:

1) Send the PO to ChannelCloud with the following memo line: "ChannelCloud reseller ID: CC-987654 — Redwood Inference CPPO RWI-2027-1229-CT"
2) In parallel, please sign the DocuSign order form here: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/7a3c8b (I’ve prefilled the company and PO number)
3) Once signed, ChannelCloud will process the CPPO and AWS will activate the entitlement (we will monitor ACT-4821).

HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3241590/RWI-2027-1229-CT

If you prefer Redwood to receive the PO directly, we can accept that too; email invoices@redwood.com and include the memo above.

Thanks — we’ll be on standby to confirm once AWS activates the CPPO.

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
